title: Sockpuppet Noir
description:
Список возможностейGAMEPLAY FEATURES:

• The game contains 3 unique cases for you to crack, with different themes and characters.

• Over 20+ unique fully voiced sock puppets await your sharp intellect through your questioning.

• Connect your own microphone and do your own dialogue, with the socks wobbling up and down as you speak.

• A dynamic notebook collects all important pieces of information, to give your brain a break, including your own notes.

Об игреNew Drawer was a city of sin, a cesspool of all the lowest scum you could find. If they weren't already pink by the mishandled wash of corruption, you could bet they were lost and alone, doomed to search forever for their lost partner. 

And in the middle of all this mess, there was I. Frank Sockowski, Private Detective. 

I made my coin by looking into the dirty heels of this city, snooping around, and solving crime. 

GAMEPLAYAs a private detective (and woolly sock) it is your duty to investigate gruesome cases. Armed with the sharpest wits in New Drawers and your trusty magnifying glass, you get information through interrogation, classic sleuthing around crime scenes, and getting gossip from the local bar. 

You unlock new clues as you progress the story, and once you are confident in your findings, you can carry out an arrest on your main suspect.

CASESThe game currently have 3 cases, with around 2-3 hours of gameplay each.

• Shot and Directed - At the Holeywood studio, disaster strikes as in the middle of a hero-vs-villain climax, a pistol goes off with a loaded round. Detective Sockowski is forced to dive into the world of production fraud, actress drama and cinema fanatism to get to the root of this dastardly crime.

• Puppets of Power - A grizzle murder happens in the city high-rise, right in the richest and most powerful district of New Drawer. A district attorney with ties to all layers of society, and a grieving newly millionaire widow will test Detective Sockowski's sleuthing skills.

• Stabbed at Sea - Taking a break from the dark city and boarding the S.S. Herringbone, Detective Sockowski and his new femme fatale ally takes on a murder before it even happens! But suddenly, the light dims, and the world gets turned upside down, and sadly no one will be left alive to enjoy the chef's famous Charlotte cake!

PRODUCTIONThis game was initially made during the Global Game Jam 2021 but has since been expanded, adjusted, voiced, and polished. 

The main crux was that we had no artists in our team, so we had to improvise. But we had a bunch of socks and some googly-eyes on hand, so sock puppets were made, filmed on a green screen, and put into the game.

It has a cast of amateur voice actors from our circle of friends.

AI Generated Content DisclosureThe developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

The game's writing, code, characters, voicework, and design were created by humans without the use of generative AI.

Some assets are made from freelancers or purchased off asset/stock sites that promised us it was not generative AI. We later discovered that some of these assets contained AI-generated material. We are replacing these assets as they are identified.
description_short: Step into the shoes of Frank Sockowski, private detective, and explore the gritty world of New Drawer, a wolly unsettling and corrupt city. Three delicious cases await your sleuthing skills, each with unique roster of colorful socks and murderous plots.
